Name: Simple Quality Indicators (SQI)
Author: Halfwolf102
Description:
Replaces the default star shaped quality indicators. The replacement can be configured either in the config.json file or using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]. Additionally, the indicators can be transparent or have a background.
[u][b]
Quality Levels:[/b][/u]
Quality levels for each indicator is as follows:
(Silver, Gold, Iridium)
[list]
[*]Letters: S, G, I
[*]Grades: C, B, A
[*]Numbers: 3, 2, 1
[*]Dice: (3 dots), (2 dots), (1 dot)
[*]Symbols: +, ++. +++
[/list]
[u][b]
Config Options[/b][/u]

[b]IndicatorType[/b]
[list]
[*][u]Description:[/u] Type of indicator to use when showing item quality.
[*][u]Allowed Values:[/u] Letters, Grades, Numbers, Dice, Symbols
[*][u]Default Value:[/u] Letters
[/list]
[b]EnableBackground[/b]
[list]
[*][u]Description:[/u] Enables background for item quality indicators.
[*][u]Allowed Values:[/u] true, false
[*][u]Default Value:[/u] false
[/list]

[b][size=4]Also available on [url=https://www.curseforge.com/stardewvalley/mods/simple-quality-indicators]Curseforge[/url][/size][/b]
